import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
import matplotlib.colors as mcolors
import numpy as np

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 10,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
    'pdf.fonttype': 42,
    'ps.fonttype': 42,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox_inches': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
})

DEEP_BLUE = '#0072B2'
ORANGE_RED = '#D55E00'

outdir = '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0509_15/projects/vla-ssd/artifacts/figures/paper'

# Data
models = ['OpenVLA', 'TracVLA', 'NORA']
dims = ['Goal', 'Spatial', 'Object', 'Long']
transitions = ['VLA→VLA', 'VLM→VLA', 'VLM→VLA']

data = np.array([
    [0.016, 0.037, 0.037, 0.004],
    [0.228, 0.138, 0.294, 0.198],
    [0.691, 0.302, np.nan, np.nan],
])

mask = np.isnan(data)

# Colormap: white to deep blue
cmap = mcolors.LinearSegmentedColormap.from_list('w2blue', ['#FFFFFF', DEEP_BLUE])
cmap.set_bad('#E0E0E0')

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 3.5))

im = ax.imshow(data, cmap=cmap, vmin=0, vmax=0.75, aspect='auto')

nrows, ncols = data.shape

# Cell borders
for i in range(nrows):
    for j in range(ncols):
        rect = plt.Rectangle((j - 0.5, i - 0.5), 1, 1, fill=False, edgecolor='#CCCCCC', linewidth=0.5)
        ax.add_patch(rect)

# N/A cells: hatching
for i in range(nrows):
    for j in range(ncols):
        if mask[i, j]:
            rect = plt.Rectangle((j - 0.5, i - 0.5), 1, 1, fill=True, facecolor='#E0E0E0',
                                  edgecolor='#999999', linewidth=0.5, hatch='///', zorder=2)
            ax.add_patch(rect)
            ax.text(j, i, 'N/A', ha='center', va='center', fontsize=10, color='#888888', zorder=3)

# Annotate cells with transition type + value
for i in range(nrows):
    for j in range(ncols):
        if not mask[i, j]:
            val = data[i, j]
            txt_color = 'white' if val > 0.35 else '#222222'
            # Transition type (smaller)
            ax.text(j, i - 0.18, transitions[i], ha='center', va='center',
                    fontsize=7.5, color=txt_color, style='italic', alpha=0.85)
            # Value (bold)
            ax.text(j, i + 0.18, f'{val:.3f}', ha='center', va='center',
                    fontsize=10, fontweight='bold', color=txt_color)

# Thick separator between OpenVLA (row 0) and TracVLA (row 1)
ax.axhline(y=0.5, xmin=0, xmax=1, color='#444444', linewidth=1.5, zorder=5)

# Category labels on the left
ax.text(-0.85, 0, 'VLA→VLA', ha='center', va='center', fontsize=7.5, color='#555555',
        rotation=90, transform=ax.get_yaxis_transform())
ax.text(-0.85, 1.5, 'VLM→VLA', ha='center', va='center', fontsize=7.5, color='#555555',
        rotation=90, transform=ax.get_yaxis_transform())

ax.set_xticks(range(ncols))
ax.set_xticklabels(dims)
ax.set_yticks(range(nrows))
ax.set_yticklabels(models)
ax.tick_params(length=0)

# Colorbar
cbar = fig.colorbar(im, ax=ax, fraction=0.025, pad=0.04)
cbar.set_label('ΔR²', fontsize=10)
# Threshold line at 0.10
cbar.ax.axhline(y=0.10, color=ORANGE_RED, linestyle='--', linewidth=1.2)
cbar.ax.text(1.3, 0.10, '0.10', transform=cbar.ax.get_yaxis_transform(),
             va='center', ha='left', fontsize=7.5, color=ORANGE_RED)

ax.set_xlim(-0.5, ncols - 0.5)
ax.set_ylim(nrows - 0.5, -0.5)

fig.savefig(f'{outdir}/fig_matrix_heatmap.pdf')
fig.savefig(f'{outdir}/fig_matrix_heatmap.png', dpi=300)
plt.close()
print('fig_matrix_heatmap done')

ax.legend(loc='lower right', framealpha=0.9, edgecolor='#CCCCCC', fontsize=9)

ax.tick_params(axis='y', length=0)

fig.savefig(f'{outdir}/fig_l1_attention.pdf')
fig.savefig(f'{outdir}/fig_l1_attention.png', dpi=300)
plt.close()
print('fig_l1_attention done')
